race.comment: HE'SGOTTHESAY (6) has made an encouraging start to the prep and should be hitting his straps now fourth-up. Boasts a good record here and if he brings his A-game he's the one to beat. MIRRA IMPACT (1) is knocking on the door and doesn't have to improve much here to land the winning blow. Gets aid under the top weight with Apel's 3kg claim. Drawn a dream and should be right there when they quicken. ROCHEDALE HERO (7) finished alongside He'sgotthesay last time but concedes weight to him now, so will need to raise the bar again. The draw is also a knock but they could look to spear across and be handy. Which is what ITALIAN DANCER (3) will also look to do from out there, and can give his supporters another great look. HALF LISTENING (10) was much better second-up on firmer footing at Eagle Farm. Has more in store third-up from a long break and is one to keep in mind.
